issues.title: Warning message on use of `Cancel`.
issues.body:
A user believes that quite a long COA document was lost when he pressed `Submit`.  That was frustrating.

A colleague suspects he actually pressed `Cancel`. 

We should popup a dialog check the user is sure they wish to `Cancel` the document.

This is specific to the `COAStatusBoard`, really.

*Note:* this will probably go into the NewMessage logic. But, we should add a prop to indicate whether to show the warning on Cancel --since there are lots of times when the form is simple and we don't need to check.
